title: Getting started
description: Create your account, connect your first store and list your first item in about ten minutes.
text:
Relistic keeps one list of everything you sell. You add an item once, tick the stores it should appear on, and Relistic posts it to each of them. When it sells on one store, Relistic takes it down (or lowers the stock) everywhere else.

## 1. Create your account
- Go to app.getrelistic.com/signup.
- Type your name, your business name, your email address and a password.
- Click Create account. Your 14-day free trial starts now. You don't need a card.

## 2. Find your way around

The menu on the left has everything you use day to day:
- Dashboard: your sales, fees and profit.
- CRM: the people who bought from you, with your notes.
- Inventory: every item, and which stores it's on.
- Sales: every sale, with fees, costs and profit.
- Photo batches: turn a pile of photos into draft listings with AI.
- Automations: eBay offers and relisting.
- Activity: a log of everything Relistic did, and any problems.

Click your name at the bottom of the menu for Stores, Shipping, Team, Account settings and Billing. On a phone, tap the menu button at the top first.

Using Relistic on your phone? Add it to your home screen so it opens like an app.

## 3. Connect a store

Click your name, then Stores, and connect the stores you sell on. Each one has its own short guide in Connect your stores. For Poshmark, Depop, Mercari, Grailed, Facebook Marketplace and Whatnot, see The Chrome extension.

## 4. Add your items

There are three ways, and you can mix them:
- Import your current eBay or Etsy listings, so they start syncing straight away.
- Upload photos in a photo batch and let the AI write the listings.
- Type an item in yourself.

## 5. Sell

That's it. When something sells, Relistic updates your other stores within minutes and puts the order on the Shipping page. Read How syncing works to see exactly what happens.

title: Add Relistic to your phone or computer
description: Put a Relistic icon on your phone's home screen or your computer, so it opens full screen like an app.
text:
Relistic works in any web browser, and you can add it to your phone's home screen or your computer so it opens with one tap, full screen, like an app. There's nothing to download from an app store.

Log in at app.getrelistic.com first, in the browser you'll use. You stay logged in when you open Relistic from the icon.

## iPhone or iPad, with Safari
- Open Safari and go to app.getrelistic.com.
- Tap the ⋯ button in the bottom right corner.
- Tap Share.
- Tap View More.
- Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
- Leave the name as Relistic and tap Add.

Don't see ⋯? On older iPhones, tap the Share button instead (a square with an arrow pointing up, at the bottom of the screen), then scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.

## iPhone or iPad, with Chrome
- Open Chrome and go to app.getrelistic.com.
- Tap the Share icon (a square with an arrow pointing up) at the right end of the address bar.
- Tap Add to Home Screen.
- Tap Add.

## Android, with Chrome
- Open Chrome and go to app.getrelistic.com.
- Tap the ⋮ (three dots) in the top right corner.
- Tap Add to Home screen (on some phones it says Install app).
- Tap Install or Add. If your phone asks, tap Add again to place the icon.

## Windows or Mac computer, with Chrome or Edge
- Go to app.getrelistic.com.
- Look at the right end of the address bar for a small install icon (a screen with a down arrow) and click it. No icon? In Chrome, click ⋮, then Cast, save, and share, then Install page as app. In Edge, click ⋯, then Apps, then Install this site as an app.
- Click Install.

Relistic opens in its own window, and you'll find it in your Start menu (Windows) or Applications folder and Launchpad (Mac).

## Mac, with Safari
- Go to app.getrelistic.com.
- In the menu bar at the top of the screen, click File, then Add to Dock.
- Click Add.

## Good to know
- The icon always opens the latest version of Relistic. There's nothing to update.
- The Chrome extension for Poshmark, Depop and the others still needs Chrome on a computer.
- To remove the icon, press and hold it on your phone and choose Remove or Delete, like any app.

title: Connect your stores
description: Connect eBay, Etsy, Shopify and TikTok Shop to Relistic, and finish each store's settings so it can list.
text:
Relistic connects to eBay, Etsy, Shopify and TikTok Shop through each store's official sign-in. You approve access on the store's own page, so Relistic never sees your password. You can disconnect at any time.

## Open the Stores page
- Log in at app.getrelistic.com.
- Click your name at the bottom of the left menu.
- Click Stores.

Each store shows one of these:
- Connected and ready to list. You're done.
- Connected. Settings needed before listing. Fill in the settings under that store and click its Save button.

## eBay
- On the Stores page, click Connect eBay.
- eBay's sign-in page opens. Sign in to your eBay seller account and click Agree.
- You come back to the Stores page. Under eBay, choose your Shipping policy, Payment policy and Return policy, and type your Ship-from ZIP code.
- Click Save eBay settings.

No policies yet? eBay calls your shipping, payment and return rules "business policies". If you don't have any, click Create my eBay policies under eBay and Relistic makes a simple set for you, which you can change later on eBay.

## Etsy
- First, in your Etsy shop, make sure you have at least one shipping profile, a return policy and a processing profile (Etsy Shop Manager, Settings).
- On the Relistic Stores page, click Connect Etsy.
- Sign in to Etsy and click Allow access.
- Back on the Stores page, choose your Shipping profile, Return policy and Processing profile, and answer Who made your items?
- Click Save Etsy settings.

Etsy only allows resold items that are vintage (20 or more years old) or craft supplies. Relistic asks When was it made? on each item you list on Etsy.

## Shopify
- On the Stores page, find Shopify and type your store's address, the one that ends in .myshopify.com (for example yourshop.myshopify.com). You can find it in Shopify under Settings, Domains.
- Click Connect Shopify.
- Shopify asks you to install Relistic. Click Install.

Each item you list becomes a product in your Shopify store. When it sells somewhere else, Relistic lowers its stock, or sets it to Draft when none are left.

## TikTok Shop
- On the Stores page, click Connect TikTok Shop.
- Sign in to your TikTok Shop seller account and click Authorize.
- Back on the Stores page, type your Usual package weight (pounds) and click Save. TikTok needs a weight on every product.

TikTok checks each new product before it goes live, so new listings can take a little while to appear.

## Reconnect or disconnect
- Reconnect signs in to the store again. Use it if Relistic says a store's access has expired.
- Disconnect removes the store and deletes the access Relistic held for it. Your items stay in Relistic.

## The other stores

Poshmark, Depop, Mercari, Grailed, Facebook Marketplace and Whatnot don't let other apps post for you, so they work through the Relistic Chrome extension. See The Chrome extension.

title: The Chrome extension
description: Add the Relistic extension to Chrome to list on Poshmark, Depop, Mercari, Grailed, Facebook Marketplace and Whatnot.
text:
Poshmark, Depop, Mercari, Grailed, Facebook Marketplace and Whatnot don't let other apps post listings for you. So Relistic uses a Chrome extension that works inside your own browser: it opens the store's listing page and fills in the photos, title, description and price. You check it and press the store's own Post button. When the item sells somewhere else, the extension reminds you and opens the listing so you can delete it or mark it sold.

You need the Google Chrome browser on a computer. Chrome extensions don't work on phones.

## Step 1: Add the stores
- In Relistic, click your name at the bottom of the left menu, then Stores.
- Scroll down to Poshmark, Depop, Mercari, Grailed, Facebook Marketplace and Whatnot.
- Click Add next to each store you sell on (for example Add Poshmark).

## Step 2: Install the extension
- On the same Stores page, under The Relistic extension, click How to add the extension to Chrome, then Download the extension. A file called relistic-extension.zip is saved.
- Open your Downloads folder and double-click the file. A folder called relistic-extension appears.
- In Chrome, click in the address bar at the top, type chrome://extensions and press Enter.
- In the top right corner of that page, turn on the Developer mode switch.
- Click Load unpacked in the top left, choose the relistic-extension folder and click Select.
- Click the puzzle piece icon to the right of the address bar, then the pin next to Relistic, so its icon stays in the toolbar.

Don't delete the relistic-extension folder afterwards. Chrome runs the extension from it.

## Step 3: Connect it to your account
- Go back to the Relistic Stores page and reload it.
- Click Connect the extension.
- You'll see Connected as and your email address.

## Step 4: Stay signed in to each store

Open each store's website in the same Chrome and sign in as you normally would. The Stores page shows Signed in on Chrome next to each store it can see you're signed in to.

## Posting a listing
- On an item, tick the store (for example Poshmark) under Where to list it, set Status to Active and save. The listing now waits in the extension.
- Click the Relistic icon in Chrome's toolbar. It shows the listings waiting to post.
- Click Post next to one. The store's listing page opens with the photos, title, description and price filled in.
- Fill in anything the store still needs, such as category, size or condition.
- Press the store's own Post or List button. Relistic records the new listing.

## Updating and taking down listings

The extension's window also shows two other kinds of jobs:
- Update (Changed in Relistic): you changed the item's price or details. Click Update and the extension opens the listing's edit page with the new details filled in. Save it on the store.
- Take down (Sold elsewhere): the item sold on another store. Click Take down and the extension opens the listing. Delete it or mark it sold on that store, then click the button in the Relistic bar at the top of the page to tell Relistic it's done.

Open the extension at least once a day, and straight away after a sale, so nothing sold stays up on these stores.

The extension checks for work every minute while Chrome is open. Click Check now in its window to check straight away. It never opens tabs or posts anything on its own; you always click first.

title: Add and edit items
description: Add an item by hand, choose which stores it goes on, set a different price per store, and keep your inventory organized.
text:
Every item in Relistic is one master record: title, description, price, quantity, condition and photos. You tick the stores it should appear on, and Relistic keeps all of those listings matched to it.

## Add an item
- Click Inventory in the left menu.
- Click Add item in the top right.
- Fill in the Title, Description, Condition, Brand, Price (USD) and Quantity. The SKU is filled in for you, but you can change it.
- Optional: type What you paid. Only you see it; the dashboard uses it to work out your profit.
- Optional: add Tags, your own groups separated by commas, such as Bin 4, Women's denim, and Private notes. Only you see these; they're never sent to a store.
- Under Where to list it, tick each store this item should appear on.
- Set Status to Active (list on the stores ticked below). Leave it on Draft if you're not ready; drafts aren't listed anywhere.
- Click Save + Sync. Relistic posts it to each ticked store and shows the result on the item.

Save or Save + Sync? Save keeps your changes in Relistic only, which is handy while you're still working on an item. Save + Sync also sends them to your stores.

### Photos

On the item page, drag photos from your computer onto the photo area, or click Add photos and choose them. An item can have up to 20 photos. For many items at once, a photo batch is quicker.
- The first photo is the main one. Drag a photo to a new spot to change the order, or use the ← and → arrows under it.
- Click a photo to see it bigger.
- Click Delete under a photo to take it off the item.
- Click Remove background to cut the item out and put it on a white background. It's free and runs on your own computer or phone; the first time takes a minute to get ready. The new photo goes next to the original, and Undo puts the original back.

Photo changes are kept when you click Save or Save + Sync.

## Store-specific details

Some stores need extra details. Relistic asks for them on the item when that store is ticked:
- eBay: a category and its item specifics. Use the category finder on the item page, and click to fill the specifics eBay requires with AI.
- Etsy: a category and When was it made?
- TikTok Shop: a category is optional; if you leave it empty, Relistic uses the one TikTok suggests for the title.

### Compare prices

Click Compare prices in a store's section on the item page to help you price:
- Sold prices on eBay: how many similar items sold in the last 90 days and for how much, with a button to use the middle (median) price. Until eBay approves Relistic for sold-price data, this says Sold prices: coming soon.
- Asking prices of similar items for sale now on eBay and Etsy. These aren't sold prices.

## A different price or title on one store
- On the Inventory page, find the item, click Options ▾ on its store (for example eBay) and click Edit for eBay. If it isn't on that store yet, click List on in its store column instead.
- In the pop-up, change the title, description, condition, price or photos for that store only.
- Click Save.

Anything you leave empty uses the item's main details.

## Edit an item

Click the item on the Inventory page, change anything, and click Save + Sync. Relistic updates every store it's listed on. If a store had a problem, click Sync now to try again.

## Remove an item

On the item page, click Archive and end listings. The item ends on every store and moves to the Archived tab, so your history and profit numbers stay correct.

## Find items fast

See Find and organize your inventory for tabs, filters, favorites and duplicates, and Bulk crosslist to list many items at once.

title: Photo batches (AI listings)
description: Upload a pile of photos and let the AI listing assistant sort them into items and write each listing for you.
text:
A photo batch turns a pile of photos into draft listings. Shoot each item one after another, upload all the photos at once, and Relistic's AI sorts them into items and writes a title, description, condition, brand, item details and a suggested price for each. You check the drafts, fix anything, and post them.

## Before you start
- Photograph one item at a time: all of item 1's photos, then all of item 2's, and so on. That's how the AI tells them apart.
- Put your best photo of each item first. It becomes the main photo.
- A photo of a label or tag helps the AI find the brand and size.

## Make a batch
- Click Photo batches in the left menu.
- Click New batch.
- Drag your photos onto the box that says Drop photos here, or click to choose, or click it and pick the photos.
- Wait while the photos upload. They're shrunk on your device first, so it's quick.
- Let the AI group the photos by item, or move each photo by hand. Check each item has the right photos.
- The AI writes each listing. Each one becomes a draft item with its own SKU, like B12-3 (item 3 of batch 12).

To delete photos you don't want, tick them and click Delete. To delete a whole batch, use Delete on the batch; items already made from it keep their photos.

## Review and post
- Under Review drafts, check each title, SKU, price and condition. Change them right there if needed.
- Under Post to:, tick the stores each draft should go on.
- Click Edit everything to open the full item details right under the draft. Make your changes and click Save; you stay on the batch. (Open on its own page is there too.) Click Discard and redo to have the AI try again.
- Anything that would stop a draft posting, such as a missing category, is listed under it. Fix it first.
- Tick the drafts that are ready and click Post listings (it shows how many, for example Post 4 listings). They're listed on your stores straight away.

Click Download CSV to save the whole batch as a spreadsheet.

## Schedule drafts for later

Instead of posting everything now, you can let Relistic post the ticked drafts later:
- Tick the drafts you want to schedule.
- Choose All at once and pick a start time, or Spread out: a number of listings a day, between two hours (for example 5 a day between 9 AM and 6 PM).
- Click Schedule (it shows how many, for example Schedule 20 listings).

Scheduled drafts show in the Scheduled tab in Inventory, with the time each one posts.

## Draft settings

Click Draft settings on the Photo batches page to change how the AI writes:
- Title word order: drag the parts of a title (like brand, item type, size, color) into the order you like. The example shows how titles will look.
- Your own SKUs: turn on Read my SKU from a photo. Photograph a sticker or card with your own code (like BIN4-017) with each item; the AI uses it as the SKU and leaves that photo off the listing.

Click Save settings. Changes apply to drafts written from then on.

## How many photos?

Plan | Photos per batch | AI drafts a month |

Free trial and Starter | 250 | 50 |

Pro | 500 | 300 |

Business | 1,000 | 1,000 |

Each item the AI writes counts as one AI draft.

If you've connected eBay, each draft also gets eBay's best-matching category, and the AI fills in the item specifics eBay asks for in that category.

title: Bulk crosslist and price rules
description: List many items on several stores at once, and set a price rule per store, like Poshmark +10% ending in .99.
text:
## List many items at once

Bulk crosslist puts a group of items on more stores in one go, for example every item you imported from eBay onto Etsy and Poshmark.
- Click Inventory in the left menu.
- Tick the box next to each item you want to list. To pick every item on the page, tick the box at the top of the list.
- Click Crosslist in the bar that appears (it shows how many, for example Crosslist 12 items). A pop-up opens with three steps.

### Step 1: Stores and titles
- Under Which stores?, tick the stores to add the items to.
- Under Titles, choose Shorten long titles with AI to fit each store or Keep titles as they are. Only titles over a store's limit change, and only on that store. If you keep them, a store may turn down a title that's too long.
- Click Next.

### Step 2: Prices

For each store, pick how its price is set from the item's main price:
- Price rule: uses the store's price rule (shown only when the store has one; see below).
- Same as main price.
- Raise by % or Lower by %, then type the percent.

The example shows what one of your items will cost on each store. Click Next.

### Step 3: Drafts or publish

Under When should they go up?:
- Publish now posts them to the stores you picked right away. Drafts among them are also posted to the other stores already ticked on them.
- Save as drafts ticks the stores, with your prices and titles, on each draft so you can check them and post later. This only works for items that are still drafts; already-listed items are skipped.

Click Crosslist (or Save … as drafts) and keep the pop-up open while it works. When it's done, it says how many were listed and lists any item that needs a fix, such as a missing category, so you can open it and finish it. Click Back to change an earlier step, or Cancel to stop before starting.

Use the tabs and filters first to narrow the list, for example the Listed tab with Any store set to eBay. See Find and organize your inventory.

## Price rules per store

Stores charge different fees, so you may want different prices on each. A price rule changes an item's price automatically on one store, without typing a price per item.
- Click your name at the bottom of the left menu, then Stores.
- Scroll down to Price rules.
- Next to a store, type a percent under Raise or lower by. Use a minus sign to lower, for example -5.
- Under Rounding, choose whether prices end in .99, are rounded to whole dollars, or are left as they are.
- Check the example under A $40.00 item becomes.
- Click Save price rules.

The rule is used wherever you haven't typed a price for that store on the item, and it's offered as Price rule in step 2 of Crosslist. A price you type in Price on this store always wins. The Inventory page and the Chrome extension show the price after the rule.

title: Import your current listings
description: Bring the listings you already have on eBay and Etsy into Relistic, already linked so they sync.
text:
Already selling on eBay or Etsy? Import your live listings so they're in your Relistic inventory and start syncing straight away. You don't have to list them again.

## Import
- Connect the store first (see Connect your stores).
- Click your name at the bottom of the left menu, then Stores.
- Under eBay or Etsy, click Import my listings.
- Keep the page open while it works. It reads your listings a page at a time and adds each one to Inventory.

## Good to know
- No duplicates. If a listing has the same SKU or title as an item already in Relistic, it's linked to that item instead of copied. If you sell the same item on both eBay and Etsy, import one store, then the other, and they'll be joined.
- Run it again any time. Click Import again to pick up new listings. Listings imported before are skipped.
- Listings with variations (several sizes or colors in one listing) are skipped for now.
- Plan limits. Imported items count toward your plan's active listings. The import stops at your limit.

eBay listings made on eBay's own website are synced for price and quantity only. Relistic ends them when the item sells elsewhere and relists them if it comes back, but their title, photos and description stay as they are on eBay.

After importing, you can tick more stores on each item to crosslist it there too.

title: Find and organize your inventory
description: Use tabs, filters, favorites, private notes and the Duplicates tab to keep your inventory tidy.
text:
## Tabs

Click Inventory in the left menu. The tabs along the top sort your items:

Tab | What's in it |

All | Everything except archived items. |

Listed | Items set to Active. |

Drafts | Items not listed anywhere yet. |

Scheduled | Drafts set to post later, in the order they'll go up. |

Sold | Items with none left. |

Delisted | Active items that were taken off their stores and aren't up anywhere. |

Favorites | Items you starred. |

Duplicates | Items that look like the same thing entered twice. |

Archived | Items you archived. |

## Search and filters

Type in Search title or SKU, choose a store, status or tag, and click Search. The status filter also finds problems: Needs attention, Waiting in extension, Active but not listed anywhere and Missing SKU.

Each store has its own column, with the store's logo at the top. When an item is listed there, the cell shows the photo the store is using.

## Work on items right from the list
- Favorite: click the star next to an item.
- Cost and private notes: click the box in the row, type, and press Enter. Notes are never sent to a store.
- Missing SKU: this badge means the item still has an automatic SKU from a batch or import. Open it to type your own.
- Store menu: click Options ▾ on a store to View on the store, Edit for that store only, Take off that store, or Move to another item if a listing got linked to the wrong item.

## When listings fail

If some listings didn't post or update, a Some listings failed to post banner appears at the top. Click See which, fix what's missing, then click Retry. To clear them instead, click Discard and confirm: listings that never went up are unticked for that store, and live listings stay up.

## Duplicates

The Duplicates tab finds items that may be the same thing entered twice: very similar titles, SKUs that only differ by punctuation or leading zeros, and items that share a photo. Each row says which item it looks like (for example Same photo as), and look-alikes sit next to each other so you can compare.
- If they really are the same, archive the extra one, or use Options ▾, Move to another item to join its listings to the one you keep.
- If they're different items, click Not a duplicate and the row disappears from the tab.

title: How syncing works
description: What Relistic does when you change an item or when it sells, and how fast each store is updated.
text:
Relistic keeps every listing matched to the item it came from. Here's exactly what happens, and when.

## When you click Save + Sync

Save on its own keeps changes in Relistic only. Save + Sync sends them to your stores:
- Ticked stores where it isn't listed yet: Relistic creates the listing.
- Stores where it's already listed: Relistic updates the title, description, price and quantity.
- Stores you un-ticked: Relistic ends the listing there.

The result for each store shows on the item and in Activity. If something goes wrong, Relistic explains it in plain words, for example a missing category, so you can fix it and click Sync now.

## When an item sells
- Relistic finds out about the sale. Etsy tells Relistic within seconds. eBay, Shopify and TikTok Shop are checked every 5 minutes.
- The item's quantity goes down by the number sold.
- If there are some left, every other store is updated to the new quantity.
- If none are left, the item is marked Sold and ended on every other store.
- The sale shows on your Sales page and Dashboard, the buyer appears in your CRM, and the order is ready on the Shipping page.

Chrome extension stores (Poshmark, Depop, Mercari, Grailed, Facebook Marketplace and Whatnot) can't be changed by other apps. When an item sells elsewhere, the extension shows a Take down job and opens the listing for you to remove. See The Chrome extension.

## Overselling

If two stores sell the same item before Relistic can take it down, Relistic counts each sale once and flags the extra one as an oversell in Activity, so you can contact the buyer quickly.

## The Activity log

Click Activity in the left menu to see everything Relistic has done: each listing created, updated or ended, each sale, and any problems. It's the first place to look if something doesn't look right on a store.

title: Sales and profit
description: See every sale with its fees, costs and profit, add sales by hand, and edit them in a spreadsheet.
text:
The Sales page lists every sale from your connected stores, with what you earned and spent on each, and works out the profit per sale.

## The Sales page
- Click Sales in the left menu.
- Pick a period at the top: All time, Today, Last 7 days, This month, Last month, This year, Last year, or Custom dates.
- Each row shows the photo, store, SKU, how many sold and how many are left, then the money: price, shipping charged, sales tax, refund, store fees, shipping cost, cost of goods and other costs. Click a sold item's title to open its listing on the store.
- Click any amount to change it, then press Enter. Profit updates straight away.

Profit is price plus shipping charged, minus refund, fees, shipping cost, cost of goods and other costs. Sales tax is shown but not counted, since it goes to the state. Totals for the page are at the bottom.

Fees in grey italics are estimates from the store's standard rates. Type the real amount to replace them. If there's no cost of goods, profit counts the item as free, so fill in Cost of goods (or What you paid on the item).

Use the search box and Any store to find sales. Each row also has links to open the order on its store and Print label on the store; sales you added by hand have Open Shipping instead.

## Year-end profit and loss (P&L)

For taxes, pick the year in Year and click Year-end P&L (PDF). It downloads a PDF that adds up that year's sales, refunds, fees, shipping, costs and profit by month and by store, ready to give your accountant.

## Add a sale by hand

For a sale Relistic didn't see, like one in person or on a store that isn't connected:
- On the Sales page, open Add a sale by hand.
- Pick the store, then type the date sold, title, price, quantity and any shipping charged and store fees.
- Type the item's SKU to link it to the item in your inventory.
- Tick Take it out of stock if you want Relistic to lower the item's quantity and update your other stores.
- Click Add sale.

## Edit sales in a spreadsheet
- On the Sales page, pick the period you want, then click Download spreadsheet. The file has the sales in that period.
- Open it in Excel or Google Sheets and change any amounts. To add sales, add rows with no Sale ID (they need Store, Date and Title).
- Save it as a CSV file.
- Open Upload a sales spreadsheet, choose the file and click Upload.

Uploading the same file twice doesn't add anything twice.

The Dashboard uses the same numbers, so changes here show there too.

title: Shipping labels
description: Connect your Shippo account, buy shipping labels for your orders, and send tracking to the store automatically.
text:
Relistic lists your recent orders in one place and buys shipping labels through your own Shippo account. Postage is billed to you by Shippo at their rates, not by Relistic. When you buy a label, the tracking number is sent to the store for you.

## Set up shipping (once)

### 1. Get your Shippo key
- Create a free account at goshippo.com and add a payment method there.
- In Shippo, click Settings, then Advanced, then API.
- Under Live Token, click Generate Token and copy it. It starts with shippo_live_.

### 2. Add it to Relistic
- In Relistic, click your name at the bottom of the left menu, then Shipping.
- Under Set up shipping, paste the token in 1. Your Shippo key and save.
- In 2. Where you ship from, type your return address and save.
- In 3. Your usual box, type the size and weight of the box you use most and save. You can change it on each order.

Want to practice first? A Shippo test token (it starts with shippo_test_) buys free sample labels and never sends tracking to your stores.

## Ship an order
- Go to Shipping. Orders from the last 30 days without a label are under Ready to ship.
- Click Ship next to the order.
- Check the parcel size and weight. Weigh it packed: carriers charge extra if the weight on the label is too low.
- Choose a service. The cheapest is marked.
- Click Buy for and the price (for example Buy for $5.40), then click Print label.

The tracking number goes to eBay or Etsy automatically. If it didn't, click Send tracking again under Labels bought.

Buyer addresses are read from the store when you buy the label and are not saved in Relistic.

title: eBay automations
description: Accept and decline offers automatically, send daily offers to watchers, and relist items that haven't sold.
text:
Automations do routine eBay selling tasks for you. Set them once and Relistic runs them every day.
- Click Automations in the left menu.
- Find your eBay store and change the settings below.
- Click Save eBay automations.

## Best Offer

Lets buyers send you offers, and answers them for you. Both numbers are a percent of each listing's price, so one setting works for every item.
- Auto-accept offers at or above (% of price): for example, 90 on a $50 item accepts offers of $45 or more. 0 means never.
- Auto-decline offers below (% of price): for example, 70 on a $50 item declines offers under $35. 0 means never.

Offers in between are left for you to answer on eBay.

## Offers to watchers

Once a day, Relistic sends a discount to people watching your listings, using eBay's official offer feature.
- Discount (% off the price): how much to take off.
- Message to buyers (optional): for example, "Thanks for watching! Here's a little discount."

## Relist listings that haven't sold

Fresh listings get more views. Relistic ends listings that have been up a while without selling and lists them again, optionally a little cheaper each time.
- Relist after (days without selling): how long to wait.
- Lower the price each relist by (%): 0 keeps the same price.
- Never go below (% of the item's price): for example, 70 on a $50 item stops dropping at $35.
- Most listings to relist per day: keeps it gradual.

title: Dashboard and CRM
description: See your sales, fees and profit by store and month, and keep notes on your buyers.
text:
## Dashboard

Click Dashboard in the left menu. Choose a period at the top: Last 30 days, This month, Last month, This year or All time.
- Sales: what buyers paid for items, with shipping charged shown underneath.
- Items sold and the average sale.
- Store fees: what the stores took.
- What you paid: your cost for the items sold, from the What you paid box on each item.
- Profit: sales minus store fees and what you paid. Shipping isn't included yet.

Below that, In stock now shows how many items are active, what they're worth at your prices and what you paid for them, followed by tables By store and for the Last 12 months.

Profit is only right if you fill in What you paid on your items, or Cost of goods on the Sales page. The dashboard also counts refunds and other costs you enter there.

## CRM (your buyers)

Click CRM in the left menu to see everyone who has bought from you on a connected store, what they bought and when. Repeat buyers are marked.

Type a note about a buyer (for example "prefers fast shipping") and click Save note. Only you see your notes.

Buyers show up after your first sale. Some stores, such as Shopify and TikTok Shop, don't share buyer details with apps, so those sales appear without a buyer.

title: Team logins
description: Give helpers their own login to your Relistic account, and choose which pages each one can use.
text:
On the Pro and Business plans you can give helpers, like an assistant or a family member who lists for you, their own login to your Relistic account. Each helper sees only the pages you choose, and never your store connections or billing.

Plan | Helpers |

Free trial and Starter | None |

Pro | 2 |

Business | 5 |

An invite that hasn't been used yet counts as a helper until it's used or cancelled.

## Invite a helper
- Click your name at the bottom of the left menu, then Team.
- Under Invite a helper, type their email address in Their email.
- Under Pages they can use, tick each page they need. You can choose from: Dashboard, CRM, Inventory and the Chrome extension, Sales, Photo batches, Automations, Activity and Shipping labels.
- Click Make invite link.
- Click Copy, then paste the link into a text or email to your helper. Relistic doesn't send it for you.

The link works once, for 7 days. Send it only to the person you're inviting.

## What your helper does
- Open the invite link.
- Type their name and choose a password (10 or more characters).
- Click Join the team.

From then on, they log in at app.getrelistic.com with their email and password. Their menu shows only the pages you ticked.

## Change or remove a helper
- Change their pages: on the Team page, under Helpers, tick or untick pages and click Save pages.
- Remove them: click Remove helper and confirm. They're logged out straight away and can't log in again. Anything they listed or changed stays.
- Invite not used yet: under Waiting to join, click New link to make a fresh link (the old one stops working), or Cancel invite.

## What helpers can't do

Helpers never see the Stores, Billing or Team pages, and can't close the account. Only you, the account owner, can connect stores, change the plan or manage the team.

title: Plans, billing and your account
description: Choose or change your plan, update your card, change your details, or close your account.
text:
## Your free trial

Every new account gets 14 days free with 100 active listings and 50 AI drafts. No card is needed. Choose a plan any time during the trial; you keep the days you have left, and your card is charged when the trial ends.

## Choose or change your plan
- Click your name at the bottom of the left menu, then Billing.
- Pick Starter, Pro or Business.
- Enter your card on Stripe's secure page and confirm.

To switch plans or update your card later, click Manage billing on the same page.

Plan | Price | Active listings | AI drafts a month | Team logins |

Starter | $19.99/month | 100 | 50 | None |

Pro | $39/month | 500 | 300 | 2 |

Business | $79/month | Unlimited | 1,000 | 5 |

An active listing is one item set to Active, however many stores it's on. Team logins are extra logins for helpers; see Team logins.

## Cancel

On the Billing page, click Cancel subscription and confirm on Stripe's page. Changed your mind? Use Manage billing to keep your plan.

When a plan ends, your items and history are kept and sales keep syncing so nothing oversells. You can't post, edit or use the AI until you choose a plan again.

## Change your name, email or password
- Click your name, then Account settings.
- Change your name, business name, email or password and save.

Billing, Team and closing the account are only for the account owner. Helpers don't see them.

## Close your account

In Account settings, click Close account. This permanently deletes your account and everything in it: items, sales, buyer notes and store connections. Cancel your subscription first so you're not charged again. Read the privacy policy for more.

title: Common questions
description: Quick answers about stores, syncing, the Chrome extension, photos, billing and your data.
text:
### Can I ask Relistic a question while I'm working?

Yes. Click Ask Penny in the bottom right corner of any page in Relistic. Penny is Relistic's AI help assistant: type your question and press Send, and she answers in a few steps and links the help guide that covers it. Click New chat to start over. Penny is AI and can make mistakes, so check the guide if something doesn't match what you see.

### Which stores does Relistic work with?

eBay, Etsy, Shopify and TikTok Shop connect directly. Poshmark, Depop, Mercari, Grailed, Facebook Marketplace and Whatnot work through the Chrome extension.

### Does Relistic know my marketplace passwords?

No. You sign in on each store's own page and approve access. Relistic stores only the access the store gives it, encrypted, and deletes it when you disconnect.

### My item didn't appear on a store. What do I do?
- Check the item's Status is Active. Drafts aren't listed anywhere.
- Check the store is ticked under Where to list it.
- Look at the message under the store on the item page, or in Activity. It says what's missing, such as a category.
- On the Stores page, make sure the store says Connected and ready to list.
- Fix the problem and click Save + Sync (or Sync now) on the item.

### How fast do other stores update after a sale?

Within a few minutes. Etsy sales arrive within seconds, and eBay, Shopify and TikTok Shop are checked every 5 minutes. Chrome extension stores need you to click Take down in the extension. See How syncing works.

### Can I use Relistic on my phone?

Yes. It works in your phone's browser, and you can add it to your home screen so it opens like an app. The Chrome extension needs Chrome on a computer.

### Can someone help me list?

Yes, on Pro (2 helpers) and Business (5 helpers). Each helper gets their own login and sees only the pages you choose. See Team logins.

### Why does Etsy want to know when my item was made?

Etsy only allows resold items that are vintage (20 or more years old) or craft supplies, so it asks for every listing.

### How do I add photos to an item?

On the item page, drag photos onto it or click Add photos. For many items at once, use a photo batch. You can reorder, delete and remove backgrounds on the item page.

### Who pays for shipping labels?

You pay Shippo directly through your own Shippo account. Relistic doesn't add anything. See Shipping labels.

### Is my data safe?

Connections are encrypted, store access keys are encrypted again by Relistic, and each account can see only its own data. We never sell your information. See the privacy policy.

### How do I get help?

Email angela.b@apeirosmarketing.com.
